hook: Eight Moscow meetings collapsed, and border war erupted instantly.

sections.voiceover: Eight Moscow meetings collapsed, and border war erupted instantly.
b_roll: Map of Moscow displaying the summit location
Split screen graphic showing diplomatic talks failing

sections.voiceover: Zamir Kabulov confirmed the eighth meeting ended without a joint statement. Tensions shattered diplomacy after disagreements between the Taliban and Pakistan. Where did the 8th meeting go wrong?
b_roll: Map highlighting Afghanistan and Pakistan borders

sections.voiceover: Fighting instantly crossed into Paktia province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, but the collapse was only the beginning.
b_roll: Border map showing Paktia and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provinces
Satellite view of rugged terrain near the border

sections.voiceover: The 203 Mansouri Corps engaged Pakistani troops directly. Armed clashes surged near the Durand Line in Dand Patan district. The 203 Mansouri Corps traded heavy fire along the frontier.
b_roll: Insignia and emblem of the 203 Mansouri Corps
Map zooming in on the Durand Line and Dand Patan district

sections.voiceover: Zamir Kabulov reported the failed talks.
b_roll: Strategic map highlighting the border escalation
Final wide shot of the frontier region
